name: SkyWars [SEASON 3!] ✨
desc:
Loot chests, gear up, bridge to islands, and fight to be the last player standing! Show your combat skills in this fun and fast-paced game, and claim your place as the greatest warrior in the sky! ⚔️☁️

Feel free to provide feedback via our social links. 

Thanks for playing! ⚡️
